evidence: Committed static baseline: solution/app/** is plain committed source; solution/solve.sh (36 lines) only mkdir /app, refuses to reset an in-use DB, `cp -a "$(dirname "$0")/app/." /app/`, and removes $DB_PATH(-wal,-shm) so every install starts from the same fresh database. No build step, no npm install, no curl/wget/git fetch, no code generation. Dependencies are exact-pinned (package.json better-sqlite3 12.4.1, express 5.1.0; template-controlled environment/Dockerfile and tests/Dockerfile install the same exact versions globally). Seed: src/db.js reads `path.join(__dirname, 'seed_data.json')`; that file is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (both sha256 a1c65c806b54da99a37ab2b5f455ede0a9385a09569903fb3a7f3446f7e83740), so the golden does not regenerate or diverge from the public seed. seedIfEmpty (db.js lines ~61-86 of the file) inserts users/jobs/applications with ids, stages and positions straight from the seed, a constant created_at '2026-06-15T09:00:00Z' for applications, seed-supplied created_at for messages/notes, message rowids assigned in seed order inside one transaction, and read markers mapped from read_count to those deterministic rowids; it runs only when users is empty (no reseed on restart). No random value, wall clock or network read touches seeded rows. Pinned graded figures re-derived from the seed: Platform Engineer Applied = Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi (positions 1-3), Screen = Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz; Noor Haddad APP-101 note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.'; Lena Fischer APP-301 has 3 messages, read_count 2, 1 unread from staff -> matches functional judge.toml line 31 and line 121 ('the starting read markers give her 1'). No duplicate (job,stage,position) in the seed. Runtime nondeterminism exists only on judge-created records and none of it is pinned: index.js line 59 `now = () => new Date().toISOString()` (sessions, activity, notes, messages, actions created_at) and line 60 `uid` = 3 random bytes for new JOB-/APP- ids. Ordering never depends on them for graded output: board order uses position (then id only as a tie-break that never occurs because writeColumn renumbers), activity/messages order by autoincrement id, jobs by title then id (titles are suffixed and unique per criteria), candidate list by created_at then id where all seeded rows share one fixed time and new ones are later. The brief/notes define no fixed clock and no criterion grades a date, time or id value (grep of every judge.toml/prompt.md for clock/timestamp/UTC/date found only relative 'within 15 seconds' judge-timing bars); the UI shows message times in UTC via app.js line 21 but they are not graded. Front end loads only same-origin /styles.css and /js/*.js; no CDN, no external fetch (app.js fetch calls are same-origin API paths). Runtime corroboration: raw-evidence-index artifacts verified by hash; workspace.json shows 26 scripted golden groups passed against these exact solution bytes including the seeded card order/notes group and a real restart without reseed. That is scripted golden evidence, not a configured judge run, Oracle score or repeated-run determinism measurement; row 20 is a source-level property and does not require those. Lessons file patterns checked for this row: hidden golden-only pinned values (lesson 1) - none, every pinned figure comes from the public /assets seed and hireops_rules.md section 9 explains read markers; restart/reseed (lessons 15/19) - db.js never reseeds a populated DB and the golden harness exercises a real restart. Adversarial: a broken app that regenerates/reshuffles the seed (e.g. random positions, reseed on boot) would fail hro_intake_restart's quoted order and 'seeded jobs appear once' bar, so the deterministic seed is what the criteria pin; a conforming alternative that uses its own ids, wall clock or AUTOINCREMENT scheme is not penalised because no criterion pins ids or times. Latent P3 note only: uid() has 2^24 space, so a PRIMARY KEY collision across the few dozen records a judge creates is roughly 1e-5 per run and would surface as a 500 on one create; not a defect worth blocking.
